requirement.original: Bug #63: Horizontal scroll indicator hidden on web for both code blocks and tables. Code blocks: showsHorizontalScrollIndicator={false} unconditionally. Tables: showsHorizontalScrollIndicator={Platform.OS !== web} which evaluates to false on web.
requirement.clarified: Show horizontal scroll indicators on web for code blocks and tables in MarkdownView.tsx. Code blocks use unconditional false; tables use inverted Platform check. Both should use Platform.OS === 'web' to show on web and hide on native.
requirement.what: Fix two incorrect showsHorizontalScrollIndicator prop values in MarkdownView.tsx
requirement.why: Web users cannot discover horizontally scrollable content (code blocks and tables) because scroll indicators are hidden

included: Fix showsHorizontalScrollIndicator for code block ScrollView (line 187)

success_criteria: Code block horizontal scrollbar visible on web when content overflows
Table horizontal scrollbar visible on web when content overflows
No scroll indicator changes on iOS/Android
constraints: Must not affect native platform UX

root_cause_analysis.symptom: Horizontal scroll indicators are hidden on web for code blocks and tables
root_cause_analysis.root_cause: Two incorrect prop values: code blocks use unconditional false, tables use inverted Platform.OS check (!== instead of ===)
root_cause_analysis.root_cause_commit: 7f178466 - fix: fix monorepo (code moved from expo-app, bug predates monorepo restructure)
root_cause_analysis.why_introduced: Original code was written primarily for mobile where hiding scroll indicators is standard UX. Web platform was not considered or the Platform check was written backwards for tables.
root_cause_analysis.why_problematic: Web users with mouse/trackpad rely on visible scrollbars to discover horizontally scrollable content. Without scrollbars, wide code blocks and tables appear truncated with no affordance for scrolling.
root_cause_analysis.timeline: Present since initial implementation, predates monorepo restructure at commit 7f178466

context.codebase_state: File is stable, last meaningful changes were for markdown link handling
context.recent_commits: e761d0a1 fix: add pointer cursor on hover for markdown links on web; 0bc200b9 fix: use raw DOM onClick for web markdown links

development_approach.strategy: Change both showsHorizontalScrollIndicator props to use Platform.OS === 'web' for consistent web-shows-native-hides behavior
development_approach.validation_approach: Visual inspection via Playwright on dev web: render a session with code blocks and tables, verify horizontal scrollbars are visible when content overflows

research_findings.reason: Straightforward bug fix with clear root cause -- inverted/missing Platform check
